asset_prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium production Linux desktop wallpaper for Toddy OS, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Brand direction: MIDNIGHT NAVY, elegant, calm, confident, with personality but not cute. Edge-to-edge sculptural folded fabric-like waves or satin paper ribbons in midnight #081426, deep navy #10233F, ocean blue #24518A and a single restrained icy blue highlight. The curves can subtly echo the soft drooping ears of a Shih-tzu without drawing a dog or any literal object. Composition: broad quiet dark navy negative space across left two thirds for desktop windows, softly illuminated overlapping folds concentrated at bottom right; exquisite controlled lighting, matte tactile surfaces, subtle fine texture, restrained depth, no bright bloom. Suitable as a real GNOME wallpaper, luxurious editorial simplicity. NO text, NO logo, NO mascot, NO dog, NO interface, NO icons, NO stars, NO circuits, NO neon, NO watermark, NO border, NO mockup. Keep the environment predominately blue, no beige, brown or purple.

Use case: lighting-weather. Create the LIGHT THEME companion wallpaper to this exact Toddy OS dark wallpaper. Preserve the broad elegant flowing ribbon composition and tactile matte subtle fabric texture. Replace the navy background with a very pale cool blue-white #EFF5FC, folds in restrained mist blue #D4E4F5 and slate blue #8DAED1, and only a small deep navy accent at the far lower right. Broad clean negative space on left two thirds, quiet gently illuminated relief, premium GNOME wallpaper. It must read as the light variant of the same identity. Landscape 16:9. No text, no logos, no mascot, no dog, no interface or watermark, no beige, brown or purple.

Premium restrained coherent companion to the input. NO logo, NO dog, NO mascot, NO letters, NO progress bar, NO fake interface, NO watermark, NO beige or purple. This is only an empty background, not a mockup.

frames.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent-background animation keyframe from the supplied Toddy OS mascot. This is the SAME adult chestnut-and-ivory Shih-tzu wearing the SAME black rounded-square glasses, identical short muzzle, warm fur, confident outlines, head angle and raised-brow personality. This is NOT a redesign. Preserve the same square-canvas framing, head scale, top tuft, ear positions, glasses placement and lower beard silhouette as closely as possible for registration in a website animation. Change ONLY the expression into the START of a bored, slightly contemptuous YAWN: eyelids heavy and half-closing, jaw beginning to open in a modest vertical oval below the nose, a tiny glimpse of tongue, no bared teeth. Expression says 'another human meeting? really?' with dry wit. No anger, no crying, no sleep bubble, no stars, no letters. The whole head is visible with the same modest clear margins as the input, not cropped. Genuine alpha-transparent background; ivory fur remains opaque. No shadow, no glow, no tile, no badge, no body, no text, no watermark. Square image. Keep the original professional illustrated identity.

Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE transparent animation keyframe, the PEAK OF A BORED YAWN, for the exact Toddy OS Shih-tzu in these references. Image 1 is the original identity and image 2 is the preceding half-yawn frame. Keep the same head scale and framing, exact head angle, top tuft, outer ear/beard silhouette, chestnut-and-ivory fur shapes, black rounded-square glasses and professional dark outlines. Do not redesign. Change ONLY eyelids and the mouth/jaw area: eyes now closed into relaxed sleepy curves behind the lenses, mouth opening into a wider/taller relaxed vertical yawn below the same nose position, small curved coral tongue visible. This must clearly read as a dog BORED by his human, not an aggressive bark or astonishment. No teeth, no paws, no accessories, no costume, no sleep letters or bubbles, no text, no badge, no shadows/glow. Preserve opaque ivory fur and genuine alpha transparency around the same complete head, modest clear margins. Same square composition as the references for smooth website animation registration. Express an understated, opinionated nerdy Shih-tzu with strong personality.
